footer.tagline: Local inventory, online. See what the shops around you have in stock, then reserve it or get it delivered by the shop.
footer.notice: Map data from OpenStreetMap contributors. Demo data: shops, prices and sales are generated for demonstration.

events.CONFIRMED: Shop confirmed and set it aside

home.heroBody: See which shops around you have it on the shelf right now, what they charge, and how fresh that stock count is. Reserve it and walk in, or let the shop deliver.
home.reserveBanner: Reserve now, pick up in 30 min
home.browseBody: The everyday things that are hard to find online and easy to find nearby.
home.shopsBody: Sorted by distance. The freshness line tells you how recently they counted their shelves.
home.howTitle: Check the shelf before you leave home
home.howBody: Pickup is the default because you get to see it before you pay. Delivery is there when the shop offers it, handled by the shop itself.

search.title: Search the way you talk
search.body: Type 'charging adapter' or 'tap leaking'. NearShop understands meaning, not just exact product names.

reserve.title: Reserve in one tap
reserve.body: The shop confirms and sets it aside for 30 minutes. You get a pickup code and a live countdown.

pay.title: Walk in, check, pay
pay.body: Inspect it at the counter and pay there. If the shop delivers, cash on delivery works too.

owners.title: Your shelf, online by this evening.
owners.body: Pick products from a ready catalogue, set your price and count. Customers nearby find you, reserve, and walk in ready to buy.

alerts.title: Reservation alerts
alerts.body: Confirm or decline with one tap.

forecasts.title: Restock forecasts
forecasts.body: Know what will run out next week.

demand.title: Local demand
demand.body: See what people nearby search for.

trust.title: Earn trust
trust.body: Fresh stock counts rank you higher.

delivery.title: Your delivery, your rules
delivery.body: Set radius, fee and free-delivery limit.

commission.title: No commission to start
commission.body: Pay at the counter, as always.

search.nothingBody: Shops nearby don't list this yet. Try a wider radius, fewer filters, or a simpler word.
search.matchingOutOfStock: Has matching items, but they're out of stock

shelfCount.other: {inStock} of {total} items in stock right now

shops.title: Shops near you
shops.description: Local shops that keep their stock online. Freshness shows when they last counted.
shops.emptyBody: Try a wider radius or another category.

layout.pitchTitle: Stop calling five shops for one spare part.
layout.pitchBody: NearShop shows what local shops actually have on the shelf, how much it costs, and how recently they counted it.

phone.label: Mobile number
phone.invalid: Enter a 10-digit mobile number that starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9, with or without +91.

code.label: {length}-digit code

sent.whatsapp: We sent a 6-digit code to {phone} on WhatsApp. It is valid for 5 minutes.
sent.sms: We sent a 6-digit code to {phone} by SMS. It is valid for 5 minutes.
sent.console: We sent a 6-digit code to {phone} (development: the code is in the API log). It is valid for 5 minutes.

code.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {seconds} s.

login.phoneIntro: Sign in with a code sent to your phone.
login.emailIntro: Sign in to reserve items and track your pickups.
login.passwordPrompt: Admin, or a shop owner with a verified phone? {link}
login.authCodeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.useCode: Sign in with a code sent to your phone

verify.title: Verify your phone number
verify.signInFirst: Sign in first, then verify the phone number on your account.
verify.adminBody: Admins sign in with their email, password and authenticator code.
verify.verifiedBody: You sign in with a code sent to {phone}.
verify.verifiedBodyNoPhone: You sign in with a code sent to your phone.
verify.unavailable: Phone verification is not available yet. Keep signing in with your email and password; we will tell you when it is.
verify.requiredTitle: Verify your phone number to continue
verify.requiredBody: Email sign-in ended on {date}. Verify your mobile number with a code to keep using NearShop.
verify.warnBody: From {date} you sign in with a code sent to your phone instead of your email and password. Verify your number now: it takes a minute.

signup.pausedTitle: Sign-ups are paused while we prepare for launch
signup.pausedBody: New accounts cannot be created right now. You can still search what nearby shops have in stock.

consent.required: I agree that NearShop uses my details to run my account and fulfil my reservations and orders, as described in the {privacy} and {terms}.
consent.ageHint: NearShop is for adults. We do not create accounts for children, because that needs a parent's verified consent.
consent.optional: Optional. You can leave these off.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp messages
whatsapp.hint: Reservation and order updates on WhatsApp.

personalised.label: Personalised suggestions
personalised.hint: Suggestions based on your search history.

measurement.label: Help improve search
measurement.hint: Use my searches to measure and improve search results.

consent.needAgree: Please agree to the privacy notice and terms to create an account.
consent.needAge: NearShop is for adults. You need to be 18 or older to create an account.

register.title: Create your account
register.phoneIntro: Reserve items at nearby shops and track pickups in one place. You sign in with a code sent to your phone.
register.emailIntro: Reserve items at nearby shops and track pickups in one place.

shopSignup.name: Your name
shopSignup.verifyNote: This number becomes your sign-in number, and your shop's phone counts as verified when an admin reviews it.

reserve.title: Reserve for pickup
reserve.description: {shop} will set it aside for you. No payment now.

check.title: The shop checks the shelf
check.body: Usually within a few minutes. You get a notification.

held.title: Held for {minutes} minutes
held.body: Once confirmed, walk in any time before the timer ends.

pay.title: Inspect, then pay at the counter
pay.body: Cash or UPI at the shop. Nothing is charged online.

reserve.notePlaceholder: e.g. Size 8 please, or I'll come by 6 pm
reserve.sentBody: You'll be notified the moment they confirm.

delivery.title: Request delivery
delivery.description: {shop} delivers this themselves. Cash on delivery.
delivery.ineligible: {reason}. Try pickup instead, or change the delivery location.

account.ownerTitle: Your activity is on your dashboard
account.ownerBody: Shop owners manage reservations from the shop dashboard. Your account and privacy settings are below.
account.nothingHeldBody: Find something nearby and reserve it. The shop sets it aside for you.
account.nextBody: Based on what people buy along with your recent purchases.
account.settingsBody: Correct your details, choose what we may use, and download or delete your data.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.required: Account and order messages are needed to run your account. To stop them, delete the account.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp messages
whatsapp.description: Updates about your reservations and orders on WhatsApp.

personalised.title: Personalised suggestions
personalised.description: Use your search history for suggestions. Off means new searches are not linked to you, and past ones are unlinked.

measurement.title: Help improve search
measurement.description: Count which results you open, without linking them to your account.

nominee.title: Nominee
nominee.body: One person who may use your data rights if you die or cannot act yourself. Support acts on it only with documentary proof.
nominee.name: Nominee's name
nominee.contactHint: Give a phone number, an email address or both.

export.title: Your data
export.body: Download your profile, choices, nominee, reservations, orders, reviews, notifications and search history as a JSON file. Up to 3 times a day.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.body: Your name, email, phone, password, home, nominee and choices are removed, and your notifications and searches deleted. Shops keep the reservations and orders they handled, without your phone or address. Reviews keep their rating and show as “Former customer”.
deletion.shopHidden: Your shop ({shops}) is hidden and its listings switched off.
deletion.scheduledInFlight: Some orders are on their way. Your account will be deleted when they close, at the latest by {date}.
deletion.cancelFirst: These will be cancelled first, and the items released back to the shop.
deletion.thenScheduled: Orders already on their way then keep your account until they close, at the latest {date}.
deletion.thenImmediate: Then your account is deleted at once.
deletion.immediate: Your account is deleted at once.
deletion.willDelete: Your account will be deleted by {date}

REQUESTED.title: Waiting for the shop
REQUESTED.body: {shop} is checking the shelf. You'll get a notification when it's set aside.

CONFIRMED.title: It's held for you
CONFIRMED.body: Walk in before the timer ends and show code {code} at the counter.

READY_FOR_PICKUP.title: Ready at the counter
READY_FOR_PICKUP.body: Packed and waiting. Show code {code} and pay at the shop.

EXPIRED.title: Reservation expired
EXPIRED.body: The shop didn't respond in time.
EXPIRED.bodyHeld: The hold time ran out and the item went back on the shelf.

reservation.pickupCodeHint: Pickup code. The shop enters it to hand over your item. Pay {price} at the shop.
reservation.cancelBody: The shop will put the item back on the shelf.

status.PENDING: Waiting for the shop to confirm

order.keepReady: Keep {price} ready. {shop} is delivering it themselves.
order.deliveryCodeHint: Give it to the person from {shop} only when the order is in your hands. Never share it by phone or message.
order.cancelBody: The shop will be notified straight away.

review.title: How was {shop}?
review.description: Reviews are only accepted for completed purchases, one per visit.
review.commentPlaceholder: Was it ready on time? Was the stock count right?
review.thanks: Thanks! Your review helps neighbours pick the right shop.
review.rulesIntro: To keep ratings honest, NearShop accepts a review only when:

rules.review_window_closed: Reviews can be written within 14 days of the pickup or delivery.
rules.account_too_new: Your account must have been created at least 3 days before the purchase.
rules.review_not_allowed: A shop cannot be reviewed from the shop’s or its owner’s phone number.
rules.phone_not_verified: Your phone number must be verified.
rules.duplicate_review: Each pickup or delivery can be reviewed once.

review.whyRefused: (this is why the review was not accepted)
review.countsNote: Only some reviews count toward a shop’s rating: one per customer per shop every 30 days.

shell.notOwnerTitle: The shop dashboard is for shop owners
shell.notOwnerBody: Sign in with a shop owner account, or list your shop in a few minutes.

draft.title: Customers cannot see your shop yet
draft.body: Verify your shop with your GSTIN, Udyam number or trade licence. You can set up everything else meanwhile.

submitted.title: Verification submitted
submitted.body: An admin is checking your evidence, usually within 2 working days. Your shop stays hidden from customers until it is approved.

rejected.title: Your verification was not approved
rejected.body: Fix the problem and submit again. Customers cannot see your shop until it is verified.

suspended.title: Your shop is suspended
suspended.body: Customers cannot see your shop until it is verified again.

renewalPending.title: Renewal submitted
renewalPending.body: An admin is checking your fresh evidence. Your shop stays visible while it is reviewed.

renew.title: Renew your verification by {date}
renew.body: Your verification ends on {date}. Submit fresh evidence before then to stay visible to customers.

expired.title: Your verification has ended
expired.body: It ended on {date}. Your shop is hidden from customers until it is renewed.

overview.demoData: Sales history includes seeded demo data so charts and forecasts have something to learn from. Real pickups and deliveries are added as they complete.
overview.noRequestsBody: New reservations and delivery orders appear here instantly.

reservations.title: Reservations
reservations.description: Customers reserve, you confirm, they pick up and pay at the counter.
reservations.emptyBody: When a customer reserves something from your shop it appears here, and you get a notification.

REQUESTED.title: New requests
REQUESTED.hint: Check the shelf, then confirm or decline

CONFIRMED.title: Held for customer
CONFIRMED.hint: Set aside. Mark ready when packed.

READY_FOR_PICKUP.title: Ready at counter
READY_FOR_PICKUP.hint: Complete when they pay and collect

orders.title: Delivery orders
orders.description: You deliver with your own staff. Customers pay cash on delivery.
orders.pickupOnlyBody: Turn on delivery in settings to accept delivery orders. You set the radius and fee; you or your staff deliver, and customers pay cash.
orders.emptyBody: New delivery orders appear here with the customer's address and route.

done.confirm: Confirmed. The customer has been notified.
done.reject: Declined. The customer has been notified.
done.ready: Marked ready. The customer has been told to come by.
done.deliver: Delivered. Cash collected and sale recorded.
done.cancel: Cancelled. Stock returned to the shelf.

code.wrongPickup: That is not this reservation's code. Check the code with the customer and try again.
code.wrongDelivery: That is not this order's delivery code. Check the code with the customer and try again.
code.deliveryDescription: Ask the customer for the 4-digit delivery code on their order screen. Hand over the order only after it is accepted.
code.pickupDescription: Ask the customer to show the pickup code on their reservation screen, and type it here.

reservation.declineBody: The customer will be told and pointed to other shops.
reservation.declinePlaceholder: e.g. Last piece just sold at the counter
reservation.cancelBody: Use this when the customer didn't show up. The item goes back into stock.

order.cancelBody: The customer is notified and any held stock goes back on the shelf.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Keep counts honest. Customers see how recently you updated, and fresh shops rank higher.
inventory.noProductsBody: Add products from the ready catalogue in a couple of minutes.

toast.removed: Removed from your shop. Past orders keep their history.

inventory.removeBody: It disappears from search. Past orders and reviews keep their history.

catalog.welcomeBody: Tick what you have on the shelf, check the price and count, and add them all at once. It takes a couple of minutes.
catalog.title: Add from catalogue
catalog.description: Ready-made listings with specs and search words. Prices start at the local typical price; change them to yours.
catalog.noMatch: Nothing in the catalogue matches. Use “New product” in Inventory to add your own.

added.one: {count} product added. Customers nearby can find it now.
added.other: {count} products added. Customers nearby can find them now.

import.noItems: No items found in that file
import.doneBody: {added} new items listed, {updated} updated. Customers nearby can find them now.
import.doneBodySkipped: {added} new items listed, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped. Customers nearby can find them now.
import.title: Import stock from Excel
import.description: The fastest way to put your whole shelf online. Export your item list from your billing app and upload it here.
import.dropHint: Needs at least an item name column. Quantity and price are picked up automatically.

export.title: 1. Export
export.body: Most billing apps (Vyapar, Tally, Marg, Busy and others) can export an item or stock report to Excel. Any sheet with an item name column works.

check.title: 2. Check the matches
check.body: We match every row to your listings and the NearShop catalogue. You review before anything changes.

import.title: 3. Import
import.body: Upload again every evening to keep counts fresh. Fresh shops rank higher in search.

import.template: No billing app? {link} and fill it in Excel or Google Sheets.

issues.typicalPrice: No price in file; using the typical local price
issues.usingMrp: No selling price in file; using MRP
issues.noQuantityUpdate: No quantity; stock will not be changed
issues.noQuantityAdd: No quantity; will be added as 0
issues.priceMissing: Price missing: enter one before importing

needPrice.one: {count} row needs a price, or set it to Skip
needPrice.other: {count} rows need a price, or set them to Skip

insights.title: AI insights
insights.description: What to restock, what people nearby are looking for, and which prices customers may question.

restock.title: Restock before you run out
restock.error: average error {mae} units per week ({pct}% better than “same as last week”)
restock.empty: Nothing is at risk of running out in the next two weeks.

area.title: What people within 3 km search for
area.hint: Last 14 days of searches near your shop.

missed.title: Searched nearby, found nowhere
missed.hint: Demand no shop in the area is meeting. Worth stocking?

bundles.title: Bought together, but you don’t stock it
bundles.alsoBuy: {pct}% of people buying {item} also buy this
bundles.empty: Your range already covers the common bundles.

prices.title: Prices customers may question
prices.note: compared with other shops selling the same item
prices.empty: Your prices are in line with shops nearby.
prices.footnote: Flags are for your review only. NearShop never hides or penalises a listing automatically.

settings.title: Shop settings
settings.description: What customers see on your shop page and in search.
settings.photoHint: A clear photo of your shopfront helps customers find you.
settings.pickupHint: Customers reserve and pay at your counter.
settings.activeHint: Turn off to pause while you are away. Nothing is deleted.

toast.savedReview: Saved. Your shop is hidden until an admin approves the new details.
toast.sentForVerification: Sent for verification. An admin usually checks it within 2 working days.

confirm.title: Hide your shop until it is checked again?
confirm.body: You changed your shop’s address or phone. Customers will not see your shop until an admin approves the new details, usually within 2 working days.
confirm.phoneRecheck: A new phone number is checked again with a call-back.

verify.title: Verify your shop
verify.intro: Customers only see shops whose registration an admin has checked. Verification lasts 12 months.
verify.callBack: We will call your shop phone to confirm it before approving.

summary.renewalPending: Your renewal is waiting for an admin. Your shop stays visible meanwhile.
summary.expired: Your verification ended on {date}. Renew it to be visible again.
summary.switchedOff: Your shop is switched off in settings, so customers cannot see it.
summary.submitted: Waiting for an admin, usually within 2 working days. Your shop is hidden until it is approved.
summary.rejected: Not approved. Correct the evidence and submit again.
summary.suspended: Suspended. Submit fresh evidence to be verified again.
summary.draft: Not submitted yet. Your shop is hidden from customers until it is verified.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Only customers who completed a pickup or delivery can review, once per purchase. Reply once to each review, in public.
reviews.emptyBody: After a pickup or delivery is completed, the customer is invited to rate it.
reviews.ratingNote: Your public rating counts one review per customer every 30 days, and shows once 5 customers have reviewed you.

toast.posted: Reply posted. Customers see it under the review.

reviews.lockedReported: A reported reply cannot be edited while an admin reviews it.

editWindow.one: Replies can be edited for {count} hour after they are posted.
editWindow.other: Replies can be edited for {count} hours after they are posted.

reviews.placeholder: Thank the customer, or explain what you have fixed.

hint.one: Shown under the review on your shop page. One reply per review, editable for {count} hour.
hint.other: Shown under the review on your shop page. One reply per review, editable for {count} hours.
